title: Russia Deploys AI Video Against James Talarico in Most Prominent Meddling Case
summary:
A fraudulent recording of a man identifying as Zyon Lewis was released to target the campaign of Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico. The deepfake video falsely claimed that Talarico sexually assaulted Lewis in 2012 while serving as a middle school teacher, and was distributed via the platform X by a covert group in Russia, according to Mediaite.

Three teams of disinformation researchers describe the operation as the most prominent foreign effort to mislead voters before the midterm elections. The operatives are attempting to meddle in the Texas race to influence the outcomes of the upcoming vote.
